name: @workspace/compile
//generate: Delegates: packages/cli is the single writer of src/generated/**, and its scripts/generate-compile-package.ts is what emits them. Kept as an entry point here because the files it writes carry a header telling the reader to run it from this package.
//smol-toml: A devDependency and not a dependency: `src/providers/codex/agent-role-toml.ts` WRITES TOML by hand — four scalars and one table — and nothing in this package's shipped surface parses any. Its spec parses every rendered role file back with a real parser, so the encoding is held against TOML rather than against the renderer's own idea of it. Declared here on 2026-09-22 after being imported and declared in no package.json in this repository: it resolved only because `knip`, a root devDependency, hoists smol-toml@1.7.1 into the root node_modules, so the import would have broken the day that tool changed or went.
